people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Erastus
people.line: Companion of Paul; served as city treasurer in Corinth.

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

translations.web: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
translations.bsb: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed for a time in the province of Asia.
translations.kjv: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
translations.asv: And having sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
